chapter: Family, Margaret's story and Eutris's memories
title: Leading a band in Cleveland with his brother
summary: He had a short-lived band with his brother in Cleveland for about nine months, then went to Boston.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: He had a little band in Cleveland, he and his brother, then he left and he went to Boston.
Who was in that band with his brother?
I don't know. I was out there once visiting and went to hear it but I couldn't tell you.
How long did that band stay together? How long did you and your brother have a band, Jay C.?
What year was that? Do you remember the year?
That was in Cleveland. I know when I had my band there.
I used to go to Cleveland and visit. I had a lot of friends lived out there but I haven't been back there for years.
I can't think of the year right now, but I do know it was -
They don't play nothing... They don't even know how to - I said shuffle, man - they don't know about no shuffling.
